## Load Library
```{r, eval=FALSE, echo =FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(rpx)
library(msdata)
library(Spectra)
library(tidyverse)
library(cleaver)
library(MSnbase)
library(tidyverse)
library(mzR)
library(PSMatch)
library(pheatmap)
library(QFeatures)
library(sageR)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(factoextra)
library(limma)
library(DEP)
library(ggrepel)
library(data.table)
library(MsCoreUtils)
```

## 1. Read evidence.txt
```{r}
library(data.table)
evidence <- read_tsv("~/Documents/CoHOLSER/run004.2_summary/run004.2_summary/evidence.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)
setDT(evidence)
```

## 2. Identify TMT reporter intensity columns
```{r}
evidence <- evidence[(is.na(Reverse) | Reverse != "+") & (is.na(`Potential contaminant`) | `Potential contaminant` != "+")]
tmt_cols <- grep("^Reporter intensity corrected", colnames(evidence), value = TRUE)
evidence <- evidence[rowSums(as.matrix(evidence[, tmt_cols, with = FALSE])) > 0, ]
```

## 3. Build assay matrix
```{r}
assay_mat <- as.matrix(evidence[, tmt_cols, with = FALSE])
mode(assay_mat) <- "numeric"
```

## Clean sample names
```{r}
colnames(assay_mat) <- str_replace(tmt_cols, "Reporter intensity corrected ", "TMT")

```

## 5. Build rowData

```{r}
row_data <- DataFrame(
  Sequence        = evidence$Sequence,
  ModifiedSeq     = evidence$`Modified sequence`,
  Proteins        = evidence$Proteins,
  LeadingProtein  = evidence$`Leading proteins`,
  GeneNames       = evidence$`Gene names`,
  Charge          = evidence$Charge,
  PEP             = evidence$PEP,
  Score           = evidence$Score,
  RawFile         = evidence$`Raw file`,
  Reverse         = evidence$Reverse,
  Contaminant     = evidence$`Potential contaminant`
)
rownames(row_data) <- evidence$id
```

## 6. Build colData

```{r}
col_data <- DataFrame(TMT_channel = colnames(assay_mat))
rownames(col_data) <- colnames(assay_mat)
```

## 7. Create SummarizedExperiment

```{r}
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(intensity = assay_mat),
  rowData = row_data,
  colData = col_data
)
```

## 8. Convert to QFeatures
```{r}
qf <- QFeatures()
qf[["psm"]] <- se

```

## Inspect
```{r}
qf
summary(qf)
class(qf)
names(qf)
colData(qf)
rowData(qf)
#rowDataNames(qf)
# Access individual assays
#assay(qf)
anyNA(assay(qf))
```
## 9. Normalize psm intensities
```{r}
## 1) Use raw intensities
# Extract raw assay
raw_assay <- assay(qf[["psm"]])

# Ensure it's a matrix
if (!is.matrix(raw_assay)) {
  raw_assay <- as.matrix(raw_assay)
}

# Now calculate fractions
frac_assay <- sweep(raw_assay, 2, colSums(raw_assay, na.rm = TRUE), FUN = "/")

## 2) Convert each sample → fraction of its total
frac_assay <- sweep(raw_assay, 2, colSums(raw_assay, na.rm = TRUE), FUN = "/")
## 3) Scale fractions (optional)
scaled_assay <- frac_assay * 1e6

## Store new assay
qf[["frac_psm"]] <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(intensity = scaled_assay),
  rowData = rowData(qf[["psm"]]),
  colData = colData(qf[["psm"]])
)

## Maintain assay links
qf <- QFeatures::addAssayLinkOneToOne(qf, from="psm", to="frac_psm")

# Extract assay
frac_assay <- assay(qf[["frac_psm"]])

# Add pseudocount to avoid log2(0)
frac_assay_pc <- frac_assay + 1e-6

# Store new assay
qf[["frac_psm_pc"]] <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(intensity = frac_assay_pc),
  rowData = rowData(qf[["frac_psm"]]),
  colData = colData(qf[["frac_psm"]])
)

# Now log2-transform
qf <- qf |>
  logTransform(
    i    = "frac_psm_pc",
    name = "log_psm"
  )
qf <- QFeatures::addAssayLinkOneToOne(qf, from="frac_psm", to="log_psm")

## 5) normalize (quantiles)
qf <- QFeatures::normalize(
  qf,
  i    = "log_psm",
  name = "norm_psm",
  method = "quantiles"
)

qf <- QFeatures::addAssayLinkOneToOne(qf, from="log_psm", to="norm_psm")


```

## 10. Aggregation
```{r}
## --- Aggregate PSMs to peptides ---
library(matrixStats)

qf <- aggregateFeatures(
  object = qf,
  i    = "norm_psm",
  fcol = "Sequence",   # your peptide mapping column
  name = "peptide",
  fun  = function(x) matrixStats::colMedians(x, na.rm = TRUE)
)

qf <- aggregateFeatures(
  object = qf,
  i    = "peptide",     # the assay you want to aggregate
  fcol = "Proteins",          # change to your protein mapping column
  name = "protein",          # name of new assay
  fun  = function(x) matrixStats::colMedians(x, na.rm = TRUE)  # aggregation function
)

qf
qf[["protein"]] |>
  assay() |>
  head()
```
## 11. Differential analysis
```{r}
library(S4Vectors)

# TMT channel names
sample_names <- colnames(qf[["peptide"]])

# Define conditions in order of your TMT channels
condition <- rep(c("Ru", "Ul", "RU", "Control", "Carrier"), each = 3)

# Define biological replicates (1,2,3 for each condition)
biorep <- rep(1:3, times = 5)

# Combine into a DataFrame
coldata <- DataFrame(
  Condition = condition,
  BioReplicate = biorep,
  row.names = sample_names
)

# Assign to peptide assay
colData(qf[["peptide"]]) <- coldata

# Verify
colData(qf[["peptide"]])
```
```{r}
# rowData
row_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(peptide_se))
row_df$name <- row_df$Sequence  # protein grouping
row_df$ID   <- paste0(row_df$Sequence, "_", seq_len(nrow(row_df))) # unique peptide ID

# colData
col_df <- as.data.frame(colData(peptide_se))
col_df$label     <- rownames(col_df)
col_df$condition <- col_df$Condition
col_df$replicate <- col_df$BioReplicate

# assay matrix
assay_mat <- assay(peptide_se)

# Combine row_df with assay matrix
row_df <- cbind(row_df, assay_mat)

# Intensity column indices
columns <- (ncol(row_df) - ncol(assay_mat) + 1):ncol(row_df)

# Make DEP SummarizedExperiment
dep <- make_se(
  row_df,
  columns,
  col_df
)

dep
# Optional: impute missing values for downstream stats
dep <- impute(dep, fun = "MinProb", q = 0.01)  # left-censored (low abundant) imputation
# Specify the comparison: e.g., Ru vs Control
dep <- test_diff(
  dep,
  type = "control",        # Control-based comparison
  control = "Control"      # Name of the control condition
)
# Add significance calls (e.g., adj. p-value < 0.05 & |log2FC| > 1)
dep <- add_rejections(
  dep,
  alpha = 0.001,      # significance threshold
  lfc = 1            # log2 fold-change threshold
)
# Check the result table
res <- get_results(dep)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)

# Define thresholds
pval_thresh <- 0.05
ratio_thresh <- 2

# Create logical columns for each comparison
sig_df <- res %>%
  mutate(
    #Carrier_sig = (Carrier_vs_Control_p.val < pval_thresh) & (Carrier_vs_Control_ratio > ratio_thresh),
    Ru_sig      = (Ru_vs_Control_p.val      < pval_thresh) & (Ru_vs_Control_ratio > ratio_thresh),
    RU_sig      = (RU_vs_Control_p.val      < pval_thresh) & (RU_vs_Control_ratio > ratio_thresh),
    Ul_sig      = (Ul_vs_Control_p.val      < pval_thresh) & (Ul_vs_Control_ratio > ratio_thresh)
  ) %>%
  select(name, #Carrier_sig, 
         Ru_sig, RU_sig, Ul_sig) %>%
  mutate(across(-name, ~ as.logical(.)))

# 2️⃣ Join peptide data to protein info
peptide_info <- as.data.frame(rowData(peptide_se)) %>%
  select(Sequence, Proteins)  # peptide → protein mapping

sig_df <- sig_df %>%
  left_join(peptide_info, by = c("name" = "Sequence"))

# 3️⃣ Collapse to protein-level significance
protein_sig <- sig_df %>%
  group_by(Proteins) %>%
  summarise(
    #Carrier_sig = any(Carrier_sig),
    Ru_sig      = any(Ru_sig),
    RU_sig      = any(RU_sig),
    Ul_sig      = any(Ul_sig)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Filter only proteins that are significant in at least one comparison
protein_sig <- protein_sig %>%
  filter( Ru_sig | RU_sig | Ul_sig)

# Minimal theme to avoid deprecated warnings
my_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Make UpSet plot
png("upset_plot.png", width = 1200, height = 800)
upset(
  protein_sig,
  names(protein_sig)[-1],  # comparison columns
  width_ratio = 0.1,
  name = "Significant proteins",
  min_size = 1,
  themes = my_theme
)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
# protein_sig has columns: Proteins, Carrier_sig, Ru_sig, RU_sig, Ul_sig
# Keep only logical/significance columns + protein name
sig_sets <- protein_sig %>%
  select(Proteins, Ru_sig, RU_sig, Ul_sig)

# Convert to long format for intersections
long_sig <- sig_sets %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Proteins,
    names_to = "Comparison",
    values_to = "Significant"
  ) %>%
  filter(Significant)

# Create a list: one element per combination of sets
intersections <- long_sig %>%
  group_by(Proteins) %>%
  summarise(Sets = paste(sort(Comparison), collapse = "_")) %>%
  group_by(Sets) %>%
  summarise(Proteins = list(Proteins)) %>%
  deframe()  # produces a named list: names = intersection, values = vector of proteins

# Check
intersections


```

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

# Your protein list (split multi-IDs first)
ids <- c(
  "O00160","O75368","P07900","P08238","P11142","P54652","P18085",
  "P23141","P26038","P15311","P35241","P35579","P35580","P35637",
  "Q92804","P50990","P50991","P62277","P62753","P78371","Q01130",
  "Q9BRL6","Q9UBE0"
)

# UniProt REST query
base_url <- "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?"
fields   <- "accession,protein_name,gene_names"
query    <- paste0("accession:", ids, collapse = " OR ")

url <- paste0(
  base_url,
  "query=", URLencode(query),
  "&fields=", URLencode(fields),
  "&format=json"
)

resp <- GET(url)
stop_for_status(resp)

content_json <- content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
parsed <- fromJSON(content_json, flatten = TRUE)

# Safely extract gene names
gene_names <- sapply(parsed$results$genes, function(x) {
  if(length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  # extract geneName.value; collapse if multiple
  paste(sapply(x$geneName.value, function(y) ifelse(is.null(y), NA, y)), collapse = ";")
})

# Construct tibble
uniprot_df <- tibble(
  accession    = sapply(parsed$results$primaryAccession, identity),
  protein_name = sapply(parsed$results$proteinDescription.recommendedName.fullName.value, identity),
  gene_names   = gene_names
)

uniprot_df
```
